# EPD International

> > The International EPD System for Environmental Product Declarations, enabling transparent communication of environmental impacts through standardized Life Cycle Assessment and Product Category Rules.

EPD International operates the globally recognized International EPD System, which provides third-party verified Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) based on Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodology. The system helps manufacturers communicate the environmental performance of their products through standardized Product Category Rules (PCR) and maintains the EPD Portal for accessing verified environmental impact data.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Product Declaration (EPD)
- International EPD System
- Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
- Product Category Rules (PCR)
- Third-party verification
- Sustainability certification
- Environmental impact data
- EPD Portal
- EPD development process
- Transparent environmental communication
- Product environmental performance
- Standardized environmental reporting
- Green building certifications
